provenance_rule: Keyword-search results and exact publication/patent front pages have different evidence strength. Search-result presence alone never establishes assignee or ownership. A front page may support document-level Applicant or Assignee attribution when the field is visible, but that attribution must not be converted into a claim about current ownership, validity, enforceability, infringement or freedom to operate.
graduation_rule: A patent-intelligence mapping is GREEN only when it distinguishes source fact from architectural inference, cites the public record, preserves independent-design evidence and escalates claim-level legal conclusions to human review.
legal_notice: Research and engineering awareness only. This ontology does not provide legal advice, patent validity analysis, infringement analysis or freedom-to-operate clearance.
